%@ param travel_time shape=T,A kind=matrix domain=time_duration :: Nominal travel time of train on arc.
%@ param original shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=time_duration :: Planned departure time of train at station before disruption.
%@ param demand shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=passenger_count :: Number of passengers of train at station.
%@ param capacity shape=S kind=scalar domain=passenger_count :: Platform capacity at station.
%@ param min_headway shape=- kind=scalar domain=time_duration :: Minimum headway between any two trains at a station.
%@ param bigM shape=- kind=scalar domain=bigM :: Large constant for big‑M formulations.
%@ var dep shape=T,S domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Departure time of train at station.
%@ var delay shape=T,S domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Delay of train at station (departure minus original).
%@ var order shape=T,T,S domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=- lo=0 hi=1 :: 1 if first train precedes second train at station.
%@ var arc_sel shape=T,A domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=1 :: 1 if train uses arc.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_delay combination=sum :: Minimize total passenger delay.
%@ con flow_link kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Link departure times with selected arcs.
%@ con arc_choice kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Exactly one outgoing arc is selected for each train at each station.
%@ con headway_precede kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Headway constraint when train p precedes q.
%@ con headway_follow kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Headway constraint when train q precedes p.
%@ con capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Station platform capacity.
%@ con delay_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Definition of delay.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}, s \in \mathcal{S}} delay_{t,s} \tag{total\_delay} \\
